title: Add an IT company to the list
description:
Add an IT company to it_companies.

Python-Gym adaptation: implement as add_company(companies, company), returning a new list with company appended to the end of companies.
hints: Adding to the end of a list is a common list operation.
You can build a new list by concatenating companies with a one-item list containing company.
Return companies + [company], or use companies.copy() then .append(company).
expected_behavior: Returns a new list with company added at the end.
explanation: Concatenating the original list with a single-item list containing the new company appends it at the end without mutating the input.
